data.title: PC İletişim Reports 52,200-Share Buy-Back on November 20
data.description:
PC Iletisim ve Medya Hizmetleri Sanayi Ticaret AS ( (TR:PCILT) ) has shared an announcement.

PC İletişim ve Medya Hizmetleri Sanayi Ticaret A.Ş. is identified as both the company conducting and the subject of the buy-back, which covers B Group PCILT shares.

Under the program, the company bought back 52,200 PCILT shares on Borsa Istanbul on 20 November 2026 at an average price of TRY 26.427 per share. The program has a maximum acquisition amount of 5 million nominal shares, a TRY 175 million allocated fund and a scheduled period from 14 September 2026 to 13 September 2027.

data.title: Boxlight Faces Nasdaq Delisting Notice Over Equity Deficiency
data.description:
Boxlight ( (BOXL) ) has issued an update.

On November 18, 2026, the SEC declared effective Boxlight’s registration statement covering the resale by selling stockholders of up to 47,466,613 Class A common shares, including shares issuable under the Series D preferred stock and equity line of credit. The effectiveness satisfied a key condition for the second tranche of the Series D financing and use of an equity line of credit of up to $15 million; funding of the second tranche remained subject to remaining closing conditions.

Also on November 18, 2026, Nasdaq notified Boxlight that its approximately $1.9 million in stockholders’ equity, reported for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, was below the $2.5 million minimum required for continued listing. The notice stated that trading could be suspended on November 30 unless Boxlight requested a hearing by November 25; a timely request would stay the suspension, while the company’s Class A common stock continued trading pending the Panel’s decision.

data.title: Exicure Announces Strategic Expansion and Investment Agreement for X-CUE
data.description:
Exicure ( (XCUR) ) has shared an update.

Exicure is a biotechnology company focused on innovative healthcare technologies, including a clinical-stage stem-cell-mobilization program, and is expanding into medical-device technologies for Parkinson’s disease and other healthcare markets. On November 20, 2026, it announced that it had entered a Strategic Business Expansion and Investment Agreement with NeuroQ Biologics and Laonz on November 19, 2026.

The agreement focused on X-CUE, an augmented-reality smart-glasses technology developed over more than a decade for patients who experience freezing of gait. The release stated that its latest, third-revised version had completed product development, while Laonz had completed the transfer of the X-CUE business, including related intellectual property, technology, assets and business rights, to NeuroQ.

data.title: CaliberCos Publishes Inaugural Investor FAQ for Shareholders
data.description:
CaliberCos, Inc. Class A ( (CWD) ) has shared an update.

On November 20, 2026, Caliber published its inaugural investor FAQ, answering 67 questions about its business model, two businesses, plans and objectives, balance sheet and stock. The FAQ used plain English, cited the relevant filings or releases and dates for figures, and included new detail on real estate Caliber owned directly or had invested in.

Caliber furnished the FAQ to the Securities and Exchange Commission and said it was intended to provide company information for prospective shareholders, rather than sales material for private funds or a prediction of the stock price. The FAQ also addressed the distinction between publicly traded stock and private fund investments, which have different risks, liquidity profiles and return drivers.

data.title: Mexico Retail Sales Slump, Raising Market Concerns
data.description:
Mexico’s retail sales growth slowed to 2.2% year over year from 3.3% previously, a decline of 1.1 percentage points, or 33.3%.

The result fell 0.5 percentage points short of the 2.7% analyst estimate, signaling weaker consumer demand. Retailers, consumer discretionary stocks and companies tied to domestic spending face near-term pressure, while the softer growth outlook may influence broader market sentiment and policy expectations.

data.title: Netcad Reports 13,000-Share Buyback Transaction
data.description:
Netcad Yazilim A.S. ( (TR:NETCD) ) has provided an update.

Netcad Yazılım A.Ş. said its board-approved share buyback program was established for three months beginning Oct. 19, 2026, with a maximum acquisition of 4 million shares and TL500 million allocated for purchases.

The company repurchased 13,000 shares on Nov. 20, 2026, at prices ranging from TL84.80 to TL85.90, equivalent to 0.00949% of capital. Following the transaction, total repurchases reached 813,035 shares, or 0.59346% of capital.

data.title: Sabancı Holding Board Resolves Tayfun Bayazıt Appointment
data.description:
Haci Omer Sabanci Holding A.S. ( (TR:SAHOL) ) has issued an update.

Sabancı Holding’s board resolved under Article 363 of the Turkish Commercial Code to appoint Tayfun Bayazıt, who resigned from an independent board-member position, as Ferda Besli’s replacement, with the appointment to be submitted for approval at the first general assembly. The board also resolved to apply to Türkiye’s Capital Markets Board for a favorable opinion on the independent-board appointment; Besli’s profile includes senior banking experience and ongoing leadership and board roles.
